reviews.x: My preteen daughter loves painting nails!  This is a fun little creepy hand that she practices on after spending 1/2 hour on Pinterest looking at different nail designs.  Polish goes on and comes off easily.
Life size hand, wish it would bend at the fingers and stay in the bent position and a stand/holder would've been nice to have.

I bought this for my 12 year old grandaughter to practice nail polishing and nail art on.  She uses it alot but you do have to just dig out the glue and polish with cuticle clippers.  I tried to find a hand that was easier to clean but this is the best one I could find.

reviews.t: This was a fun gift to give
reviews.x: I bought 2 of these to give to my granddaughters so they could practice painting nails. Gave one to my 7 yr old granddaughter for her birthday. She is loving it!

reviews.t: It's a hard plastic which makes it hard to practice ...
reviews.x: It's a hard plastic which makes it hard to practice on. Once you do nails on it the first time it is hard to take off and redo or paractice on... This is only for a display. For the price its ok but the details should be updated to be more specific.
shipped quickly and packaged well, just as described, would recommend to buyers who would like to practice nail art or hand massage
I bought this to transform it into a gorey severed hand for a Halloween party. With a bit of time, paint, makeup, fake blood, and an exacto knife, it really came together.

I bought this thinking it might be a good display hand for jewelry. The length is right, but the whole thing is way too slender to approach a normal woman's hand, fingers or wrist. It's on the anemic, anorexic side. Forget about flexing the fingers into a more natural pose. They are solid, and no amount of heating, short of actual melting will allow you to reposisiton the fingers. It's probably good for its original intention.

reviews.t: Small alien hand with huge cuticles.
reviews.x: This hand is very small, which for acrylic nail practice is less than desirable unless you will be putting acrylics on lots of children or small aliens. As other reviews have mentioned and you can even tell in the picture the cuticle bed is very high. I didn't think this would matter to me while practicing nails but it made it very difficult to file. It was cheap enough that I do not regret the purchase.
I just love my hand I do nails much better and it ended up being a good tool to keep my lil cousins away from all my stuff a hand lol but over all it works how I thought it would
A little creepy :) but it works great...nail tips fit right into the nail beds...I use it often to practice my nail art.

I was looking for a good model to display my rings and bracelets for photos. This was just what I was looking for. Very lifelike and a good color that will show them off well. Recently got a black velvet model for that, but found that when taking the pictures, that the black velvet shined and reflected the light so much that it took away from the jewelry and made a glare in the picture, also showed up every little piece of lint that attached it's self to it. Better nail deposit than my old hand.  I’m getting ready for state board exam and I found this item that is close to hand i was practicing in class with, and I must say I’m happy with my purchase!  I worried nail plate well is too deep for red color polishing staining but after I practice with hand it was no problem.

I purchased this for my 10 y/o and 4 y/o grands who love painting nails (mine!!!).  This is great for them to practice away on without having to be their guinea pig for practice manicures and pedicures!  It cleans up well with polish remover and they love playing with it for hours at a time!

reviews.t: somewhere, someone is missing a limb.
reviews.x: This thing is creepy. the fingers are long and skinny like an alien's dismembered hand. the jokes never get old about lending a hand, or the old classic of pulling your hand off when greeting another person. Oh, it works great for doing acrylic nails too.

reviews.t: I would use profanity here if I could. This ...
reviews.x: I would use profanity here if I could. This this is a piece of doody. I applied acrylic nails to it and literally cannot get those suckers off. If it's not reusable the whole thing is pointless!
The hand was purchased to display rings and has been doing ths wonderfully since purchased - delivery and price great
Really stiff but good enough to practice!

I bought this mannequin hand hoping that it would be suitable to use for taking pictures of jewelry that I might have for sale. Because it was so inexpensive, I was afraid that it would be flimsy and look cheap...boy was I wrong! It is very well made and makes a beautiful display for rings, watches or bracelets. It does not come with artificial nails but it would be very easy to purchase and apply them...I just painted the nail bed and it looks just fine that way.

reviews.t: she seems to like it a lot
reviews.x: Bought this for my little sister because she is in cosmetology, she seems to like it a lot. Fingers bend slightly to make it a little more realistic. The way the nails are shallower than the rest of the fingers is nice, because not only can you practice simple nail polish application, but you can also practice applying acrylic nails to it as well. Overall, seems to be a good product, great for practicing any type of nail applications.

I ordered this item specifically because it was advertised as a "left" hand, but it was delivered as a right.  I planned to display a specific piece of jewelry that requires a left hand, so the item is useless for that.  The item itself is of fine quality and shipped quickly (although it took USPS a long time to deliver it).  I probably won't bother returning it...maybe just use it for a halloween prop?  Dissappointed!

I like the hand but I dislike that it's hard getting false nails off of this. I wanted this to practice putting on and shaping false nail but I tried once and having a hard time removing them. The acetone that's suppose to remove the nail and glue helps but I have to let it soak repeatedly in order to completely remove the nail. Me repeatedly doing this softens the fake hand cuticle and just gets ruined.

reviews.t: Can't get the acrylics off the hand
reviews.x: So I purchased the hand to work on acrylics and tips while in Cosmetology school. After just using the hand once, I was unable to take the acrylics off and when I tried to use acetone that didn't work either. How am I suppose to work on the hand if I can't take the acrylics off!! This is total BS!

claims.text: Many reviewers find it a fun, effective practice tool for nail art, especially for kids and grandchildren.
Several reviewers describe the hand as creepy or alien-like, though some find that part of its charm.
Some reviewers complain the fingers are stiff and cannot be bent or posed, and that it is too slender or small.
A few reviewers note that polish and glue are hard to clean off the hard plastic.
Some reviewers successfully used it as a display model or prop, such as for jewelry or Halloween.
